legacy_configs.original_scripts: run unchanged when required actual data are available; original results are reference only, not complete qualification

pairs_grid.gross_entry_notional: equity split 1:beta, sum <= equity, lots rounded down; no rebalance or time stop; original simplified repository rule differs from author's extra time-stop

cross_carry_grid.sizing: capital / 14 spot-long Binance and matched BTC-short OKX; maximum original gross sleeve amount; no between-venue transfers assumed

walk_forward.fit: rolling estimates only from previously available observations; no supervised labels or OOS parameter selection
walk_forward.positions: carry across adjacent test folds, scheduled terminal exit once

execution.pairs: current completed hourly close plus prior-window estimates; next hh:01 minute open; real funding timestamp processed before later fill
execution.cross_carry: previous realized venue funding, 1-hour publication buffer, next minute fill; cannot receive prior settlement after entry

costs.impact: 0.5 * lagged 20-complete-day log return volatility * sqrt(order notional / lagged 20-day daily quote ADV)
costs.funding: actual signed settlement rate and API settlement mark for Binance; original documented pre-settlement minute close proxy for OKX; at 2x/3x multiply paid funding only, leave receipts unchanged
costs.estimate_warning: fee/spread/slippage/impact/maintenance estimates, not historical L2 or tier calibration

risk.cross_venue_ledgers: 50% initial capital spot cash, 50% perp collateral; no transfers
risk.borrow: no spot short or coin loan; perpetual shorts require collateral; enforce conservative maintenance at observed marks
risk.metadata: actual current exchange snapshot lot/tick/min_notional applied explicitly as historical simulation assumption

failure_criteria.missing_actual_data: blocked, not rejected; no fabricated observations

benchmarks: cash; pair equal initial capital long BTC/ETH and cross Binance BTC holding must be individually reserved before any evaluation, and saved as comparators, not candidate evidence
